# HeatmapChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

2D categorical matrix heatmap (cohort retention, operational matrices) with WCAG auto-contrast cell values.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ChartBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new HeatmapChart(options?: HeatmapChartOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`cellCornerRadius`](#cellcornerradius): Corner radius of heatmap cells in points.
- [`cellGap`](#cellgap): Gap between adjacent heatmap cells in points.
- [`colorScale`](#colorscale): Ordered multi-stop colour ramp (at least 2 colours) interpolated across the value range.
- [`emptyCellColor`](#emptycellcolor): Fill colour used for cells whose value is `null`.
- [`maxValue`](#maxvalue): Optional explicit upper bound for colour interpolation.
- [`minValue`](#minvalue): Optional explicit lower bound for colour interpolation.
- [`showCellValues`](#showcellvalues): Whether to draw formatted values inside cells with automatic WCAG contrast.
- [`showColorLegend`](#showcolorlegend): Whether to draw the continuous colour scale legend.
- [`valueFormat`](#valueformat): Number format for cell and legend values.
- [`valuePrefix`](#valueprefix): Prefix prepended to cell and legend values.
- [`values`](#values): 2D matrix of numeric cell values (`null` represents an empty cell).
- [`valueSuffix`](#valuesuffix): Suffix appended to cell and legend values.
- [`xCategories`](#xcategories): Column category labels drawn along the top or bottom axis.
- [`yCategories`](#ycategories): Row category labels drawn along the left axis.

### `values`

```typescript
values: readonly (readonly (number | null)[])[]
```

2D matrix of numeric cell values (`null` represents an empty cell).

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`.

Example, from `code-recipes/share-ranking-charts/heatmap-chart`:

```typescript
chart.values = [
  [100, 84, 76, 71, 68, 65],
  [100, 86, 79, 74, 70, null],
  [100, 88, 82, 77, null, null],
  [100, 90, 84, null, null, null],
  [100, 91, null, null, null, null],
];
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/chart-showcase`:

```typescript
heatmap.values = [
  [100, 84, 76, 71, 68, 65],
  [100, 86, 79, 74, 70, null],
  [100, 88, 82, 77, null, null],
  [100, 90, 84, null, null, null],
  [100, 91, null, null, null, null],
];
```
